name: Sync Backend to Hugging Face Spaces

on:
  push:
    branches: [ master ] # Triggers when you push to your master branch
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  sync-to-space:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Push Subfolder to Hugging Face
        env:
          HF_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.HF_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          # Configure Git credentials
          git config --global user.email "deploy@github.com"
          git config --global user.name "GitHub Actions"
          
          # Isolate the backend subfolder using a subtree split
          git subtree split --prefix=backend/solarcrm -b hf-deploy
          
          # Force push only the backend folder to Hugging Face
          git push --force https://archanapriya:$HF_TOKEN@huggingface.co/spaces/archanapriya/solar-crm-backend hf-deploy:main
